interface.description: The interface type to use: socket, chardev, or cuse.

daemonize.description: Whether to daemonize the swtpm process.

tpmstate_dir.description: Directory for TPM persistent state storage.

tpmstate_dir_mode.description: File mode bits for the TPM state directory (octal string).

log_file.description: Path to the log file. Use '-' to suppress logging.

log_level.description: Logging level. 5 enables libtpms debug logging.

log_truncate.description: Truncate the log file at startup.

socket_port.description: TCP port for the socket interface (if not using server config).

server_config.description: Server configuration string for socket interface. Format: type=tcp[,port=<port>][,bindaddr=<addr>][,ifname=<if>][,fd=<fd>][,disconnect].

chardev_path.description: Path to the character device for chardev interface.

vtpm_proxy.description: Create a Linux vTPM proxy device instance.

cuse_name.description: Name for the CUSE device created in /dev.

cuse_maj.description: Major number for the CUSE device.

cuse_min.description: Minor number for the CUSE device.

runas.description: User to switch to after startup (requires root).

seccomp_action.description: Seccomp action on syscall violation: none, log, or kill.

flags.description: Comma-separated flags: not-need-init, startup-clear, startup-state, startup-deactivated, startup-none.
